summary: Fresh-context reviews of the commits since the reviewed 7e42cb2 (3c03a17, 5fc9705, c07948e). CI fix (3c03a17, uutils-safe realsleep wrapper + elapsed-time floor): reproduced against Ubuntu 26.04's own rust-coreutils builds, root cause confirmed, GNU and uutils runs of all 72 tests identical; its two lows (wrong mechanism in the comment, the <= 3 bound not pinning the deadline) fixed in c07948e and re-reviewed lows-only, the bound mutation-checked and stable under load. SPA ref change (5fc9705, CodeRabbit's note): reviewed separately, lows-only. Open lows: the comment's claim holds for 26.04's updated coreutils (0.10.0-1ubuntu2~26.04.1, the runner's), not the 0.8.0 release build; buildUpdate's now-ref update and the render-time-write regression are untested.
